data.notes: January 2026’s confirmed music calendar is strongest in Courchevel 1850 and lift-linked Méribel, with luxury-club electronic bookings, La Folie Douce après-ski, and a few cultural concerts/festivals.

events.title: Concert de musique sacrée - Voix et piano / orgue
events.summary: Maestro Andrei Chevtchouk and Tatiana Derache perform a sacred-music program for voice and piano/organ at the Chapelle ND de l'Assomption in Courchevel 1850. The official Courchevel listing states the date and time as January 1, 2026, 7–8 pm.

events.title: Marten Lou at La Mangeoire
events.summary: Melodic/deep house artist Marten Lou is listed for La Mangeoire in Courchevel on January 14, 2026 at 3:00 pm. The listing places the show at Rue Park City, Courchevel.

events.title: DJ Marina Diniz at La Folie Douce Méribel-Courchevel
events.summary: Brazilian DJ Marina Diniz takes over the clubbing session at La Folie Douce Méribel-Courchevel, with DJ Ornella listed for the warm-up. Méribel’s official listing gives January 13, 2026, 3–4:30 pm, with the warm-up from 1:30–2:30 pm.

events.title: Viva Brasil!
events.summary: Courchevel’s official Brazilian Week program brings music, sunny rhythms, festive entertainment and workshops to the Courchevel 1850 snow front. The event is listed for January 20–22, 2026, from 3:30–5:30 pm each day.

events.title: Festival Jazz Variations: Elliavir in Quintet
events.summary: Elliavir performs as part of Festival Jazz Variations, blending jazz, world music, Celtic chant and pop with Oriental and Nordic influences. Méribel’s official listing confirms January 29, 2026, 9–10:30 pm at the Auditorium.

events.title: MAXI MERAKI at La Mangeoire
events.summary: Deep melodic house and techno artist MAXI MERAKI is listed for La Mangeoire in Courchevel on January 31, 2026 at 10:00 pm. The Bandsintown listing identifies the venue as La Mangeoire on Rue Park City, Courchevel.
